title.zh: 英伟达暂停向东南亚发货AI芯片
title.en: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia

summary.zh: 据报道，随着美国加紧限制AI芯片流入中国，英伟达已要求代工与制造伙伴暂停向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚发运服务器。此举可能影响东南亚数据中心建设与转口贸易，并加剧区域客户的供货不确定性。
summary.en: Nvidia has asked manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as Washington tightens efforts to keep advanced AI chips out of China. The move could disrupt data-center buildouts and re-export channels across Southeast Asia.

reports.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
Nvidia halts server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries, FT reports - Reuters

title.zh: OpenAI收紧GPT-6.2用量：Astra、Sol更快触顶
title.en: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster

summary.zh: 有用户称OpenAI削减了GPT-6.2的使用额度，其中Astra达到上限的速度快40%，Sol快25%。该消息在Hacker News引发大量讨论，焦点集中在限流策略与算力紧张。
summary.en: A user reports that OpenAI has tightened usage limits on GPT-6.2, with Astra reaching its cap 40% faster and Sol 25% faster. The post drew about 470 points and 261 comments on Hacker News, fueling discussion of rate limits and compute constraints.

reports.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster

title.zh: 科威特无人机袭击致两名意大利人死亡，特朗普称伊朗战争“我想结束就结束”
title.en: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone attack; Trump says Iran war ends 'whenever I want it'

summary.zh: 科威特发生无人机袭击，两名意大利公民身亡。美国总统特朗普就伊朗局势表态称战争何时结束“由我说了算”。伊朗外长阿拉格齐称该事件“十分可疑，像是为发动战争预先备好的剧本”。
summary.en: A drone attack in Kuwait killed two Italian nationals. President Trump said the timing of ending the Iran war is up to him. Iran's foreign minister Abbas Araghchi called the incident suspicious and likened it to a pre-cooked recipe for war.

reports.title: Two Italians killed in Kuwait drone attack; Trump says Iran war ends ‘whenever I want it’
Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility

title.zh: 泽连斯基：美国过于关心中东，对俄施压不足
title.en: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC

summary.zh: 泽连斯基接受BBC采访时表达对美不满，称美国过于关心中东，未对俄罗斯施加足够压力。他还表示，特朗普称普京为朋友“很奇怪”。
summary.en: In a BBC interview, Ukraine's president expressed frustration with the US, saying Washington is too focused on the Middle East and not pressing Russia hard enough. He also called it "strange" that Trump described Putin as a friend.

reports.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC

title.zh: 42州总检察长试图阻止Character.AI出售用户聊天记录
title.en: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats

summary.zh: 美国42个州的总检察长联合施压，试图阻止Character.AI在破产重整期间出售用户数据。他们指控该公司计划拍卖超过2100万个美国账户的私密聊天记录，侵犯用户隐私。
summary.en: A coalition of 42 U.S. state attorneys general is trying to block Character.AI from selling user data during its Chapter 11 bankruptcy. They accuse the company of planning to auction the private chat histories of more than 21 million U.S. accounts.

reports.title: 42 state AGs are trying to stop Character.AI from selling users’ chats

title.zh: 特朗普新关税意在削弱中国对全球贸易的掌控
title.en: Trump's new tariffs aim to prise global trade from China's grip - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道称，特朗普的新关税旨在削弱中国对全球贸易的掌控。报道聚焦关税对贸易格局的影响，标题未详述具体措施。
summary.en: Reuters reports that Trump's new tariffs are intended to loosen China's grip on global trade. The headline does not detail the measures or their scope.

reports.title: Trump's new tariffs aim to prise global trade from China's grip - Reuters

title.zh: 纽约时报提醒摄影师勿因AI功能升级Photoshop
title.en: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features

summary.zh: 《纽约时报》提醒摄影师不要因新增AI功能而升级Photoshop，相关条款可能涉及作品被用于AI训练或内容授权。争议凸显创作者对软件服务条款与版权风险的担忧。
summary.en: The New York Times has warned photographers against updating Photoshop because of its AI features, amid concerns that updated terms could allow their work to be used for AI training or licensing. The dispute highlights creators' worries over software terms and copyright risk.

reports.title: The New York Times warns photographers not to update Photoshop over AI features

title.zh: 中国10月工业企业利润增速升至20.1%，创五个月新高
title.en: China industrial profits growth surges to a 5-month high of 20.1% in October

summary.zh: 中国10月工业企业利润同比增长20.1%，为五个月来最高增速。经济呈现双速运行：AI相关制造业和出口拉动增长，居民消费仍然疲弱。
summary.en: China's industrial profits rose 20.1% year on year in October, the fastest pace in five months. The economy is running at two speeds, with AI-related manufacturing and exports driving growth while household consumption lags.

reports.title: China industrial profits growth surges to a 5-month high of 20.1% in October

title.zh: 感恩节大型风暴致美国多地洪水与航班延误
title.en: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US

summary.zh: 感恩节期间，大型风暴袭击美国东西海岸，带来强风、暴雨和洪水。周四晚间近百万用户断电，多地航班延误。
summary.en: A major Thanksgiving storm struck both US coasts, bringing strong winds, heavy rain and flooding. Nearly one million customers lost power Thursday evening, and flights were delayed.

reports.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US

title.zh: AI 智能体现已掌控 DeepMind 部分算力用于 Gemini 实验
title.en: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments

summary.zh: 报道称，AI 智能体已获准调度 DeepMind 的部分计算资源，用于开展 Gemini 相关实验。不过文章认为，这距离真正的递归自我改进仍很遥远。
summary.en: AI agents now allocate part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini-related experiments, according to a report. The article stresses that this does not amount to recursive self-improvement, which remains a distant prospect.

reports.title: AI agents now control part of DeepMind's compute for Gemini experiments

title.zh: llama.cpp出现AMD专用分支
title.en: AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp

summary.zh: 有开发者发布了针对AMD硬件优化的llama.cpp专用分支，旨在改善本地大模型推理性能。该项目在Hacker News获得约300分，显示社区对AMD推理生态的关注。
summary.en: A developer has published an AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp aimed at improving local large-model inference performance on AMD hardware. The project drew roughly 300 points on Hacker News, reflecting interest in AMD's inference ecosystem.

reports.title: AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp

title.zh: 独家：研究者称中国AI公司MiniMax数据被不明方访问
title.en: EXCLUSIVE: Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社独家报道，一名研究者称中国AI公司MiniMax的数据被不明身份方访问。标题未说明数据性质及影响范围。
summary.en: Reuters exclusively reports that a researcher says data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax was accessed by unidentified parties. The headline does not specify the nature of the data or the impact.

reports.title: EXCLUSIVE: Data from Chinese AI firm MiniMax accessed by unidentified parties, researcher says - Reuters

title.zh: 中国、日本、韩国与东盟启动跨境数字支付谈判
title.en: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN launch talks on digital payments across borders - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，中国、日本、韩国与东盟国家已就跨境数字支付启动磋商，目标是推动区域支付互联互通。相关谈判的具体方案与时间表尚未公布。
summary.en: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN have launched talks on cross-border digital payments, according to Reuters. The aim is to advance regional payment connectivity; details and timelines have not been disclosed.

reports.title: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN launch talks on digital payments across borders - Reuters

title.zh: 博客推测神秘模型Jev或为Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
title.en: Jev is probably Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

summary.zh: 一篇题为《延迟不会说谎》的博客通过推理延迟等特征分析，推测匿名模型Jev很可能是Qwen3.5-35B-A3B。该文在Hacker News获得关注，反映社区对模型身份溯源的热情。
summary.en: A blog post titled “Latency Doesn’t Lie” argues, based on inference latency and related characteristics, that the anonymous model Jev is likely Qwen3.5-35B-A3B. The post sparked discussion on Hacker News about identifying undisclosed models.

reports.title: Jev is probably Qwen3.5-35B-A3B

title.zh: Ubuntu 安全响应速度缓慢引发批评
title.en: Slow Ubuntu security response times

summary.zh: 安全社区讨论指出，Ubuntu 处理安全漏洞披露与修复的响应时间偏慢，引发对发行版安全流程效率的质疑。该话题在技术社区获得数百条讨论。
summary.en: A security mailing list thread criticizes Canonical for slow response times in handling Ubuntu vulnerability reports and fixes. The topic drew hundreds of comments on Hacker News, questioning the distro's security process.

reports.title: Slow Ubuntu security response times

title.zh: 新西兰执政联盟差一席未能取得议会多数
title.en: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat

summary.zh: 由新西兰国家党领导的右倾执政联盟未能获得执政所需的议会多数，距离多数门槛仅差一个席位。这一结果可能影响其组建稳定政府的能力。
summary.en: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the parliamentary majority needed to govern by one seat. The outcome may complicate its ability to form a stable government.

reports.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat

title.zh: 载有至多7000吨柴油油轮在伊维萨附近倾覆，致一人死亡
title.en: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one

summary.zh: 一艘载有多达7000吨柴油的油轮在西班牙伊维萨岛附近倾覆，造成一人死亡。西班牙海上救援部门仍在评估可能的环境损害。
summary.en: A tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes of diesel capsized near the Spanish island of Ibiza, killing one person. Spain's sea rescue service is still assessing possible environmental damage.

reports.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one

title.zh: 网站追踪 AI 辅助治愈的疾病案例
title.en: Tracking Diseases Cured by AI

summary.zh: 一个新上线的网站汇总由 AI 参与发现或辅助治疗而被治愈的疾病案例，试图量化 AI 在医学领域的实际成果。该项目在技术社区引发广泛讨论。
summary.en: A new website catalogues diseases reportedly cured with AI's help, aiming to document concrete medical outcomes attributed to AI. The project sparked debate over evidence quality and how such claims should be verified.

reports.title: Tracking Diseases Cured by AI

title.zh: Nextcloud 推出 Office 桌面应用
title.en: Nextcloud Office Desktop app

summary.zh: Nextcloud 发布桌面版 Office 应用，把其欧洲主导的在线办公套件带到本地桌面端，强化对微软与谷歌办公产品的替代方案。
summary.en: Nextcloud released a desktop version of its Office suite, bringing the European open-source productivity tools to local desktops. The move strengthens its position as an alternative to Microsoft and Google office products.

reports.title: Nextcloud Office Desktop app

title.zh: BBC调查：德国船艇经销商涉嫌向英吉利海峡偷渡团伙供货
title.en: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds

summary.zh: BBC调查发现，一名德国船艇经销商涉嫌向英吉利海峡的人口走私团伙提供船只和发动机，2026年初近三分之一的偷渡据称涉及其公司的设备。
summary.en: A BBC investigation found that a German boat dealer is suspected of supplying small boats and engines to people-smuggling gangs in the Channel. Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved equipment from his firm.

reports.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats

title.zh: 想在圣诞节给孩子买 AI 玩具？纽约州不允许
title.en: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York

summary.zh: 纽约州禁止销售 AI 聊天机器人玩具，禁令为期五年。Common Sense Media 的新研究指出此类产品存在安全隐患，包括让孩子接触不当内容及影响情感发育。
summary.en: New York has banned AI chatbot toys for five years as new research from Common Sense Media reveals troubling safety failures, including exposure to inappropriate content and risks to emotional development.

reports.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York

title.zh: 引望发布辅助驾驶新品牌“星驰”，智能汽车解决方案部件发货超1亿件
title.en: Yinwang launches driver-assistance brand 'Xingchi', smart vehicle solution parts shipments exceed 100 million units

summary.zh: 引望发布辅助驾驶新品牌“星驰”，并披露其智能汽车解决方案部件发货量已超过1亿件。此举显示其在智能驾驶领域的品牌与规模扩张。
summary.en: Yinwang unveiled 'Xingchi', a new driver-assistance brand, and said shipments of its smart vehicle solution components have surpassed 100 million units. The launch signals its expansion in intelligent driving.

reports.title: 闪电快讯 | 引望发布辅助驾驶新品牌“星驰” 智能汽车解决方案部件发货超1亿件 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 法院裁定德帕迪约将因2018年强奸指控受审
title.en: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules

summary.zh: 巴黎上诉法院裁定，法国演员热拉尔·德帕迪约将就女演员夏洛特·阿努尔德提出的2018年强奸指控接受审判。审判日期尚未确定。
summary.en: A Paris appeals court ruled that French actor Gérard Depardieu will stand trial over the alleged rape of actress Charlotte Arnould in 2018. No trial date was immediately specified.

reports.title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules

title.zh: 距金融街5公里的“中国证券大厦”：8年投入48亿为何烂尾并挂牌转让
title.en: 'China Securities Building' 5 km from Financial Street: after 8 years and 4.8 billion yuan, why it stalled and is now listed for transfer

summary.zh: 位于距金融街约5公里的“中国证券大厦”项目在8年间投入48亿元后陷入烂尾，如今挂牌转让。报道关注巨额资金投入与项目停滞的原因。
summary.en: The 'China Securities Building' project, about 5 km from Beijing's Financial Street, has stalled after eight years and 4.8 billion yuan in investment and is now listed for transfer. The report examines why the massive project failed to complete.

reports.title: 离金融街5公里的“中国证券大厦” 8年48亿投入为何烂尾挂牌转让 - 财新

title.zh: 国际足联遭网络攻击，世界杯股权出售相关文件未受影响
title.en: FIFA victim of cyber attack, files related to World Cup stake selloff unaffected - Reuters

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，国际足联遭遇网络攻击。国际足联表示，与世界杯股权出售相关的文件未受影响。
summary.en: FIFA has been the victim of a cyber attack, Reuters reported. The governing body said files related to a World Cup stake selloff were unaffected.

reports.title: FIFA victim of cyber attack, files related to World Cup stake selloff unaffected - Reuters

title.zh: Intel One Mono 字体（2023）
title.en: Intel One Mono font (2023)

summary.zh: 英特尔开源的等宽编程字体 Intel One Mono，据称针对低视力开发者的可读性需求进行了优化，采用 OFL 许可发布。该条目近期在 Hacker News 上再次引发关注，获得约 480 点赞。
summary.en: Intel's open-source monospace coding font, Intel One Mono, was designed with legibility for low-vision developers in mind and released under the OFL license. The item resurfaced on Hacker News, drawing about 480 points.

reports.title: Intel One Mono font (2023)

title.zh: Sand.ai发布视频模型MAGI-2，三家A股公司参与产业布局
title.en: Sand.ai releases video model MAGI-2, with three A-share companies involved in industry deployment

summary.zh: Sand.ai推出视频生成模型MAGI-2，三家A股上市公司参与相关产业布局。该消息来自华尔街见闻，反映国内AI视频生成领域的商业化推进。
summary.en: Sand.ai has launched its MAGI-2 video generation model, with three listed Chinese A-share companies involved in related industry deployment. The move reflects ongoing commercialization in China's AI video generation sector.

reports.title: Sand.ai发布视频模型MAGI-2，三家A股公司参与产业布局 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: 《狮子 UNIX 源码注释》：为何被秘密影印流传二十年
title.en: Lions' Commentary on Unix: Why It Was Secretly Copied for 20 Years

summary.zh: 文章讲述 John Lions 编写的 UNIX 源码注释因版权争议长期无法正式出版，只能以私下影印的方式流传近二十年。这段历史折射出早期软件文化与知识产权制度之间的冲突。
summary.en: The article recounts how John Lions' annotated UNIX source commentary, blocked by copyright disputes, circulated secretly in photocopies for nearly two decades. It reflects the tension between early software culture and intellectual-property rules.

reports.title: Lions' Commentary on Unix: Why It Was Secretly Copied for 20 Years

title.zh: Minipg：把 PostgreSQL 打包成单个可执行文件
title.en: Minipg: PostgreSQL as a Single Executable

summary.zh: 开发者发布 Minipg 项目，可将 PostgreSQL 打包成一个单一可执行文件，以简化部署与分发流程。该项目在 Hacker News 上获得约 290 点赞和数十条讨论。
summary.en: A developer released Minipg, a project that packages PostgreSQL into a single executable to simplify deployment and distribution. The Hacker News submission drew about 290 points and several dozen comments.

reports.title: Minipg: PostgreSQL as a Single Executable

title.zh: 谷歌个性化 AI 视频流专利描绘娱乐业黯淡前景
title.en: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future

summary.zh: 谷歌申请名为 My Channel 的专利，拟依据用户数据生成由 AI 定制的视频与广告信息流。该申请已被驳回，但谷歌可能上诉或重新提交修改版本。
summary.en: Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that would build feeds of personalized, AI-generated videos and ads based on user data. The patent was rejected, but Google may appeal or resubmit an amended version.

reports.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future

title.zh: 美联储加息担忧笼罩 金价走低
title.en: Gold drifts lower as Fed rate-hike fears loom - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透报道，受美联储加息担忧影响，金价小幅走低。市场关注政策前景，黄金承压。
summary.en: Gold drifted lower amid fears of Federal Reserve rate hikes. Policy concerns kept bullion under pressure.

reports.title: Gold drifts lower as Fed rate-hike fears loom - Reuters

title.zh: 美元涨势因感恩节暂停
title.en: Dollar rally pauses for Thanksgiving - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透报道，美元近期涨势在感恩节假期前暂歇。市场交投趋淡，美元走势进入盘整。
summary.en: The dollar's rally paused around Thanksgiving. Trading thinned as the market took a breather.

reports.title: Dollar rally pauses for Thanksgiving - Reuters

title.zh: 对特朗普而言，加倍推进关税关乎权力而非人气
title.en: For Trump, doubling down on tariffs is about power, not popularity - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透报道称，特朗普在关税问题上继续加码。分析认为，此举更关乎权力运用，而非争取民众欢迎。
summary.en: Reuters reports that Trump is doubling down on tariffs. The move is seen as being about power rather than popularity.

reports.title: For Trump, doubling down on tariffs is about power, not popularity - Reuters

title.zh: 猛犸象没必要把自己包装成大家买不起的样子
title.en: Mammut doesn't need to package itself as unaffordable

summary.zh: 界面新闻评论指出，户外品牌猛犸象不应刻意塑造高不可攀的高端形象。文章认为过度溢价包装不利于品牌长期经营与消费者认同。
summary.en: A Jiemian commentary argues that outdoor brand Mammut should not deliberately cultivate an unaffordable premium image. Excessive price positioning, it says, hurts long-term brand building and consumer identification.

reports.title: 猛犸象没必要把自己包装成大家买不起的样子 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: A股停牌提示：5只股票今日停牌
title.en: A-share trading halt notice: five stocks suspended today

summary.zh: 第一财经提示，今日共有5只A股股票停牌。相关停牌原因未在标题中说明。
summary.en: Five A-share stocks are suspended from trading today, according to a Yicai notice. Reasons for the halts were not specified.

reports.title: A股停牌提示：5股今日停牌 - 第一财经

title.zh: 富时中国A50指数期货开盘涨0.13%
title.en: FTSE China A50 index futures open up 0.13%

summary.zh: 富时中国A50指数期货开盘上涨0.13%，显示市场开盘情绪小幅偏暖。
summary.en: FTSE China A50 index futures opened 0.13% higher, indicating a slightly positive sentiment at the market open.

reports.title: 富时中国A50指数期货开盘涨0.13% - 第一财经

title.zh: 黄仁勋的中国难题
title.en: Jensen Huang’s China problem

summary.zh: 这期播客讨论英伟达CEO黄仁勋在中国市场面临的问题，涉及芯片走私、人才挖角和远程访问等议题。内容从市场、经济和商业角度分析出口管制下企业如何应对。值得阅读，因为它揭示AI芯片竞争与地缘政治交织下的企业策略和合规风险。
summary.en: This podcast episode examines Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s China challenge, covering chip smuggling, talent poaching and remote access. It analyzes how export controls and geopolitical tensions shape corporate strategy and compliance. Worth reading for a concise view of the business risks in the AI chip rivalry.

title.zh: 安妮特·格林改变了美国人对香水的态度
title.en: Annette Green transformed Americans’ attitude to perfume

summary.zh: 安妮特·格林是一位不知疲倦的香水行业倡导者，致力于让世界更“芬芳”，于10月8日去世，享年102岁。她通过行业组织与公共活动推动香水走向日常生活，改变了美国人的气味观念。值得阅读，因为她的经历折射出20世纪美国消费文化、营销与感官审美的变迁。
summary.en: Annette Green, a tireless campaigner for perfume and the sense of smell, died on October 8 at 102. She helped shift Americans’ attitudes by promoting fragrance through industry organizations and public campaigns. Her life offers a window into 20th-century consumer culture, marketing and changing sensory tastes.

title.zh: 黑色星期五“悖论式”促销策略背后的隐藏数学
title.en: The hidden math behind this paradoxical Black Friday sale strategy

summary.zh: 文章用博弈论解释商家“价格匹配”承诺为何可能反而让消费者付出更高代价，以及为何许多商店在黑色星期五暂停此类政策。价格匹配看似保护消费者，但在竞争与促销时点变化下会改变定价激励。值得阅读，因为它揭示了常见促销话术背后的策略逻辑，帮助消费者理解购物季的定价陷阱。
summary.en: Game theory explains why price-matching promises can paradoxically leave consumers paying more, and why many retailers disable such policies on Black Friday. The offer appears consumer-friendly but can alter pricing incentives under competition and timed promotions. Worth reading to see the strategic logic behind familiar sale tactics and the pricing traps of the shopping season.

title.zh: 对多数母亲而言，产后心理健康会改善
title.en: For most mothers, mental health improves after birth

summary.zh: 文章指出，尽管许多人被告知产后会遭遇最糟糕的心理状态，但多数母亲在分娩后心理健康反而改善。这挑战了公众对产后心理问题的单一叙事，同时提醒仍需关注少数出现严重困难的人群。值得阅读，因为它有助于更准确地理解产后心理健康，减少污名化并改进支持政策。
summary.en: The article notes that for most mothers mental health improves after birth, contrary to the widespread warning to expect the worst. It challenges a one-sided narrative while still implying that those who struggle need attention. Worth reading for a more accurate view of postpartum mental health and better-targeted support.

title.zh: 数学家为何必须依靠机器验证新结果
title.en: Why mathematicians must rely on machines to check new results

summary.zh: 随着AI辅助证明规模越来越大，许多新结果已超出人类可完整阅读和核查的范围，数学家因此越来越依赖机器验证。文章讨论这一转变如何影响数学研究的可信度、分工与发表规范。值得阅读，因为它触及AI时代知识生产的一个核心问题：当证明大到人脑难以消化时，我们如何确认其为真。
summary.en: Many AI-assisted proofs are becoming too large for humans to read and check, pushing mathematicians to rely on machines for verification. The article examines how this shift affects trust, collaboration and publishing standards in mathematics. Worth reading because it raises a core question of AI-era knowledge production: how do we confirm truth when proofs exceed human digestion?
